parts.name: Root
parts.description: The group that holds the value. It renders a div with role="group", named by Slider.Label.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable id, from which the component makes its internal ARIA ids. Give one on a server.

props.name: value
props.description:
The value: one number for one thumb, and an array in ascending order for a range with more
thumbs. You can bind it with `bind:value`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value at the start, for when you give no `value`. The default is `min`.

props.name: controlledValue
props.description:
Give your own code full control of the value. The component stops to write back to `value`,
and it reports only through `onChange`. Thus the parent can refuse a change: the parent does
not send the new value down. The default is off, because `bind:value` is the usual case and
it needs the write-back.

props.name: onChange
props.description: The component calls it on each change, also on each move of a drag.

props.name: onChangeEnd
props.description:
The component calls it when a sequence of changes ends: at the release of a key, and at the
end of a drag. A change from assistive technology ends at once. Use it for work that must
not run on each move.

props.name: min
props.description: The lowest value. The default is 0.

props.name: max
props.description: The highest value. The default is 100.

props.name: step
props.description: The distance between two values. The default is 1.

props.name: largeStep
props.description:
The distance of `PageUp`, `PageDown` and `Shift+Arrow`. The default is one tenth of the
range, and never less than one step.

props.name: minStepsBetweenThumbs
props.description: The steps that two thumbs of a range keep between them. The default is 0: they can meet.

props.name: orientation
props.description: The direction of the track. The default is horizontal.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the slider. The native inputs are disabled, and the thumbs leave the tab order.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Keeps the thumbs in the tab order, but the value does not change.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the value as invalid. The thumbs get `aria-invalid`.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the native inputs. A `Slider.Thumb` can give its own.

props.name: form
props.description: The id of the form that the native inputs belong to, when the slider is outside it.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: The format of the value in `Slider.Output` and in the text that a screen reader reads.

props.name: getValueText
props.description:
The text that a screen reader reads for a value, in place of the formatted number. The
second argument is the index of the thumb.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible name of the slider, for when there is no `Slider.Label`.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The id of the element that gives the slider its name, in place of `Slider.Label`.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: The id of the element that describes the slider, for example an error message.

props.name: children
props.description: The content: the label, the output and the track.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the root element.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the root element.

props.name: context
props.description: A bindable reference to the context, for a composition of your own.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present while the slider is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-dragging
dataAttributes.description: Present while a pointer drags a thumb.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus in the slider must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while a thumb has the focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present while the value is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The orientation: "horizontal" or "vertical".

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present while the slider is read-only.

parts.name: Label
parts.description: The accessible name of the slider. It renders a span, and the root points at it with aria-labelledby. A press on it puts the focus on the first thumb.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the label.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present while the slider is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The orientation: "horizontal" or "vertical".

parts.name: Output
parts.description: The text of the value. It renders an output element for the native inputs, with aria-live="off".

props.name: children
props.description:
The content. As a snippet with one argument, it receives the render state: `values`, `texts`
and `text`. Without it, the component shows `text`.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present while the slider is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The orientation: "horizontal" or "vertical".

parts.name: Track
parts.description: The rail. A press on it moves the nearest thumb to the pointer and starts a drag. It is position: relative, and the thumbs sit in it.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the track.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the track element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present while the slider is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-dragging
dataAttributes.description: Present while a pointer drags a thumb.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present while the value is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The orientation: "horizontal" or "vertical".

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present while the slider is read-only.

parts.name: Fill
parts.description: The part of the track before the thumb, or between the two thumbs of a range. It is position: absolute, at a position and a size in percent of the value.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the fill.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present while the slider is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-dragging
dataAttributes.description: Present while a pointer drags a thumb.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present while the value is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The orientation: "horizontal" or "vertical".

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present while the slider is read-only.

parts.name: Thumb
parts.description: The handle of one value. It renders a div at a position in percent of the value, with a native input type="range" in it. The input has the focus and the ARIA state.

props.name: index
props.description: The index of the thumb, for a range. Without it, the thumbs take the indexes in mount order.

props.name: name
props.description: The `name` of the native input of this thumb. It replaces the `name` of the root.

props.name: aria-label
props.description:
The name of this thumb, before the name of the slider. A range of two thumbs without one
gets "Minimum" and "Maximum" in the locale.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The id of the element that names this thumb, in place of `aria-label`.

props.name: children
props.description:
The content. As a snippet with one argument, it receives the render state: `value`, `text`,
`index`, `dragging` and `focused`.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the thumb.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the thumb element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present while the slider is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-dragging
dataAttributes.description: Present while a pointer drags a thumb.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus on the thumb must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the native input of the thumb has the focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-index
dataAttributes.description: The index of the thumb.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present while the value is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The orientation: "horizontal" or "vertical".

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present while the slider is read-only.
